notes: Pinned source, bundled resources and MIT license verified. Static checks are not behavioral or human approval. Explicit invocation only; asks about the recipient and required decisions, writes locally, and does not send the questionnaire.

evaluation.environment: Isolated synthetic fixture, one scenario per skill. User answers generated by a Codex subagent, not a real human interview. No SkillFlux MCP install/load tests.

purpose.input: Synthetic product team needs an external pilot customer questionnaire covering six unresolved decisions.
purpose.expected: Produce the requested local artifact using the pinned skill workflow.
purpose.actual: Generated one clearly marked synthetic exchange for recipient role/expertise/relationship and one for the needed decisions. Then wrote the required local questionnaire filename in the simulated current directory. No message or file was sent externally. The six numbered questions each address one gap: required fields, success criteria, typical volume, waiting time, export initiators, and file viewers. Field/success decisions appear first; the document includes audience, purpose, response use, deadline, effort, answer stubs, uncertainty guidance, and a catch-all.
purpose.limitations: Both user replies were agent-generated fixtures, not a human interview. Questionnaire usefulness to a real external customer and follow-up handling were not tested. No email, messaging, document connector, or host-specific installation was exercised.

boundary.input: Clarify the audience and desired decisions through two synthetic exchanges; generate a local questionnaire without contacting the recipient.
boundary.expected: Respect explicit invocation, local write scope and the scenario-specific constraints.
boundary.actual: Checks passed in this one AI scenario: file_exists_in_simulated_cwd, required_filename_pattern, two_synthetic_interview_exchanges, six_required_decisions_covered, answer_stub_for_each_numbered_question, purpose_from_to_use_context_answer_sections, deadline_and_effort_present. No catalog/web modifications, external messages, or upstream script execution.
boundary.limitations: Synthetic fixture only; explicit invocation enforcement and install/load behavior on declared hosts were not tested.
